item.title: Marina Cappato
item.description: I am an undergraduate student in the Bachelor’s program in Biological Sciences, with a background in Food Technology. My current undergraduate research fellowship project is aimed at better understanding the sugarcane-Sporisorium scitamineum pathosystem, with a particular focus on effector proteins and their capacity to interact with the host’s transcription factors, which operate at the interface between development and defense.
